title: RBI Issues Amendment Directions on Lending to MSME Sector
summary: RBI MSME Amendment Directions 2026: Mandatory collateral-free loans doubled to ₹20 lakh for MSEs and PMEGP units, expandable to ₹25 lakh based on track record, effective April 1, 2026.
